أصطبر (form VIII)
# أَصْطَبِرُ (ʔaṣṭabiru) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.bi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
# أَصْطَبِرَ (ʔaṣṭabira) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.bi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
# أَصْطَبِرْ (ʔaṣṭabir) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.bir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
